title: census.py check retries a name-resolution or connection error once and counts it apart from a blocked host
goal: census.py check retries a source whose fetch fails with a name-resolution or connection error (the 2026-09-26 log has 10 rows with 'nodename nor servname provided') once after a short pause, in the same run; a source still failing gets note dns or connect, which census.py summary counts apart from blocked and from HTTP errors, naming the hosts, so a transient resolver failure is retried by a tool, not handed to a reader; a host denied by policy keeps note blocked.
notes: Premise from kb/public/_census/2026-09-26.csv (tally run 2026-10-10): 10 live rows with evidence 'HTTP error: [Errno 8] nodename nor servname provided' went to phase 2 (7 updated, 3 confirmed), so a reader fetched pages the check could not. A host that still fails after the retry stays a counted dns row; the tool does not change resolvers.
